reason: Decided on the packet alone; I did no web research this session (no search or fetch was used). The book is 54% gross, 46% cash, diversified across EEM, TSM, EWZ, EWJ and INDA, all with stops still armed and none breached at the 10-16 close. The only fill was the SQQQ stop-loss on 10-06, which left that 10% as cash. The semiconductor selloff (10-14 to 10-16) did not trigger TSM's 15% stop here (-1.22%). Re-hedging with inverse exposure after a stop-out is not warranted, and the 2bps-per-side friction on any rebalance buys nothing without fresh information. Cash earns 4% APY while the book keeps its mandate, so I hold.
